summary: M6_2S_SECURITY_REVIEW (mode=analysis_only). Security/PII review of slice M6.2S 'registry-feed reader adapter' (event-registry-feed.v1, chief RELAY_V221 §2.4, M6-OD-018), a cumulative superset of M6.2R. In-scope rules M6-RULE-001 (Core owns the event registry — M6 never writes/invents/reconciles), M6-RULE-014 (no raw PII), M6-RULE-015 (no self-cert); in-scope fail gates M6-FAIL-007 (no evidence/false progress) + M6-FAIL-008 (raw secret/PII on a durable/export surface). ENTRY GATE verified in the state ledger: M6-P2706=RUNNING (row 266, order 264, DependsOn=M6-P2705); M6-P2705=PASS (boundary adversary, 34 outcomes, 0 in-scope FAIL-007/008 breach); M6-P2704..2701=PASS; M6-P2700=SIGNED (M6.2S entry judge). IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET_LOCKED.json LOCKED, staged-only. No missing/contradictory input -> not BLOCKED. SCOPE: 2 new modules (app/measurement/adapters/registry_feed_reader.py + app/measurement/models/registry_feed.py) + a regression; NO migration, NO gate/config change, NO HTTP client, NO new secret; consumed.py/validator.py byte-identical to M6.2R (reuse-only). RegistryFeedReader.apply(feed) consumes a PROPOSED event-registry-feed.v1 value object/dict into typed RegistryFeedRow, reusing the M6.2P ExternalSendPolicy/DataSensitivity coercers. METHOD: independent 2-layer masking scan (work/pii_scan_2s.py: canonical post_write_secret_scan patterns + a client_secret keyword + stricter supplementary) over 281 files (impl/M6.2S app+tests, test-reports/M6.2S, boundary report, prior evidence M6-P2700..2705) + line-level read of registry_feed_reader.py and models/registry_feed.py (to_public). SCAN RESULT: CANONICAL 0 token shapes / 0 secret assignments (incl. 0 client_secret) / 0 raw user-id / 0 emails / 0 phones (authoritative pack gate clean, incl. the new reader + feed model + mock feed + SMK-031 test); supplementary 7 broad-sk (all risk-* prose; canonical sk-{20,}=0 confirms none real), 3 DIGIT_RUN non-hex (carried synthetic placeholder psid in test_b1_psid_hash.py, benign per M6.2O), 0 psid-literal; REAL keyword=VALUE 1 (carried pepper = resolve_pepper(...) function-call assignment, benign); REAL high-entropy tokens (risk-* excluded) 0. Every non-canonical hit is carried; the reader adds ZERO — the feed is CORE-OWNED GOVERNANCE METADATA (event codes/groups/domains/enum tokens/ISO timestamps), NOT customer PII; NO HTTP client and NO endpoint credential (client_secret=0, the live M3 endpoint is not built). Zero raw PII, zero real secrets. THE READER — fail-closed, PII-safe, no-HTTP, no-secret (verified on the code): feed-level guards (not-Mapping->feed_error:not_mapping; registry_version not int OR is bool->feed_error:bad_version [bool explicitly excluded, line 78]; events not list/tuple->feed_error:bad_events; non-Mapping row->feed_error:row_not_mapping; missing/blank event_code->feed_error:missing_event_code) — every reject leaves version+rows UNCHANGED; staleness no-downgrade (version <= self._version -> stale, incl. equal; version bumps only on a fully-valid feed so a malformed higher-version feed cannot poison staleness); ALL-OR-NOTHING (parse all rows first then upsert, never half-applied); fail-closed resolution reusing M6.2P coercers (unknown/None external_send_policy -> BLOCKED_DEFAULT never a fabricated ALLOW_EXTERNAL; unknown/None/SENSITIVE data_sensitivity -> PII; is_active is True strict-bool -> False; optional metadata -> None never invented); RULE-001 (only mutator is apply(); no insert/create/write/register/reconcile verb, no invented vocabulary, no enum reconciliation; NO HTTP import, no live endpoint, no egress surface). RS5 (the feed is the PATH external_send_policy enters the pack from M3; the reader is a faithful consumer that opens no egress): it fail-closes unknowns to BLOCKED_DEFAULT (never fabricates ALLOW_EXTERNAL) and FAITHFULLY READS a Core-classified ALLOW_EXTERNAL row (correct — RULE-001, Core owns the registry, M6 classifies but does not override or decide the permit-mapping); reading opens NO egress (no send verb; EXTERNAL_SEND Final OFF; which events are permit-mapped ALLOW_EXTERNAL is the OPEN M6-OD-003) — so even a Core-set ALLOW_EXTERNAL row is inert here; the hard egress controls remain EXTERNAL_SEND OFF + M6-OD-003, unchanged by this slice. P2 (PRIMARY, = boundary F-FEED-PII): RegistryFeedRow.to_public() (models/registry_feed.py:37-47) exports the 7 governance fields (event_code/data_sensitivity/external_send_policy/is_active/event_group/domain/updated_at) VERBATIM with no masking choke; a contract-violating M3 feed that smuggled a PII-shaped value into a free-text-ish field (event_group/domain) would export it raw. ADJUDICATION (sharper than the boundary's 'reject or mask'): these are GOVERNANCE IDENTIFIERS not PII (event_code e.g. ORDER_VERIFIED, event_group, domain, enum tokens, is_active, updated_at) — they MUST export as-is (masking event_code/event_group/domain would break validation, same reasoning as campaign_id; PII_FIELDS['EventRegistryRow']=() is correct). So the defense-in-depth is NOT export masking — it is an INPUT-SIDE reject of a PII-shaped value on the free-text metadata at parse (an email-shaped reject on event_group/domain, false-positive-safe, the raw-PII-tripwire pattern), so a contract-violating upstream cannot land raw PII in a governance field. Reachability: armed-not-fired — the feed is a TRUSTED Core-owned governance source (not channel/customer data), PII_FIELDS is empty by contract, and there is NO durable sink (N1). -> SECURITY M6-P2706 / owner: an input-side PII-shape reject as defense-in-depth. N1 (HONEST WIRING STATE — P2's containment is the absence of a durable sink): to_public's free-text echo stays out of FAIL-008 ONLY because it reaches no durable sink — PII_FIELDS has no RegistryFeedRow key AND no non-test app module imports the reader or feed models (grep-clean across app/); same 'M3-side adapter built ahead of wiring' pattern as M6.2R's mapper (N8); P2 FLIPS to a live FAIL-008 the moment any app module serializes to_public output or the live M3 seam is wired — a standing watch-item for the M6-OD-011 owner-controlled integration, where the input-side reject should land before wiring. SECRET HANDLING (forward): verified now — no endpoint credential in code (no HTTP client, no endpoint URL/auth/secret; client_secret scan=0); the reader consumes a value object, not a live call. Forward condition: when the live M3 client to GET /api/v1/internal/event-registry?since_version={n} (ENTRY-003 V221 pending) is built, any credential must be a secret_ref (never raw), and the M6.2O AST import-scan gate (no HTTP client in app/) will need its allow-list updated DELIBERATELY for that one client — owner-controlled integration (M6-OD-011), not this slice (same shape as the M6.2R ops-core client_secret handover). ACCESS CONTROL (doc §22 line 429): M6.2S adds NO admin API / worker authorization — the reader is a value-object consumer; the live M3 feed endpoint is forward (ENTRY-003 V221 + M6-OD-011). No new authz surface. CONSENT: unchanged (the reader adds no consent enforcement point). HASH POLICY / M6-OD-003: N/A (reading the registry sends nothing external; external_send Final OFF); the reader classifies external_send_policy but opens no egress; permit-mapping half OPEN. UNTRUSTED-INPUT: the feed is consumed cross-module input treated fail-closed (every unknown -> most-restrictive member; every malformed shape -> feed_error UNCHANGED; staleness no-downgrade); carried M6.2P coercion nit (boundary N5): _resolve_send_policy/_resolve_sensitivity have no isinstance(str) gate before the enum value-lookup, so a hostile __eq__/__hash__ object could coerce to ALLOW_EXTERNAL/PUBLIC — IN-PROCESS code-exec only (a JSON feed off the wire yields str/None/int, all handled fail-closed) -> CODER add the isinstance(str) gate. DATA-INTEGRITY/ROBUSTNESS (boundary N2/N3/N4, not PII): mutation-phase atomicity (N2 -> CODER build upsert into local copies + swap in one guarded block), int-subclass staleness bypass (N3 -> CODER canonicalize int(version)), untrimmed event_code split (N4 -> CHIEF per RULE-001: canonicalize/reject non-canonical event_code, do NOT self-resolve the Core registry semantics) + tombstone-by-omission contract note (chief). CARRIED (unaffected): the decision-export masking family OwnerDecision (M6.2R F-SEC-2R-1) + AdsSpendImportDecision (M6.2Q MC-09) reason/audit_ref -> M6-OD-012; the trace-id family + F-EVID-4/5/6; B1 real-pepper + privacy/legal -> M6-OD-003. GOVERNANCE POSTURE UNCHANGED AND IMMUTABLE: global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF, HASH_POLICY_RATIFIED=False; config.py/consumed.py/validator.py byte-identical to M6.2R (reuse-only, no gate/config change). Analysis-only: no application code/test/migration/state-ledger/release-flag/gate/config change; no live HTTP / real network / egress; no CRM send, no commission, no Data-Mart trigger, no Core override, no event write/invent/reconcile (RULE-001/018); wrote only work/pii_scan_2s.py + the security report + this evidence JSON; no enabling value written anywhere. No raw secret/PII in this evidence (the feed fields are governance metadata). status=PASS is my honest security self-report; it does NOT self-certify gate advancement (RULE-015) — the runner EVIDENCE_GATE and the slice Judge M6-P2709 decide closure.
